name: Undead
description: The endless armies of the dead that overrun humanity's holdings and rise again from the fallen.

timeline.summary: A scout reports that the Fourth Legion is lost and River's Glen overrun, and Brenalt reveals it was his home.
timeline.quote: The Fourth Legion is lost. The dead have overrun both Greenfield and River's Glen.

timeline.summary: Brenalt, now crippled and leading a few dozen survivors, sees a necromancer directing the dead below.
timeline.quote: The necromancer was real, after all.

relations.note: Brenalt takes him for the driving force behind the dead.
relations.quote: The existence of a necromancer or demon as the driving force behind the enemy had been theorized

pages_say.description: The endless armies of the dead that overrun humanity's holdings and rise again from the fallen.
